reference.title: Scenario 5 — Equation in a procedure step
reference.shortdesc: Consider a task topic where a numbered <ol><li> step contains a <math> element placed as

section.p: Consider a task topic where a numbered <ol><li> step contains a <math> element placed as a block equation after the step command text.

entry.codeblock:
1. Calculate the load using: P = I V
  2. Record the result.

<task id="calculate_load"> <taskbody> <steps> <step> <cmd>Calculate the load using:</cmd> <info> <equation-block> <mathml> <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow> <mi>P</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>I</mi> <mi>V</mi> </mrow> </math> </mathml> </equation-block> </info> </step> <step> <cmd>Record the result.</cmd> </step> </steps> </taskbody> </task>

section.p: Result: When a <math display="block"> element is placed inside a <li>item after the step command text, the converter places it inside <step><info> as an <equation-block>, binding it to the parent step. The equation adopts the procedural step's context and is rendered as part of that step's supplementary content.
